74// macros for setting values to status variable (more info at documentation of getRadarSystemState()):
75# define SET_STATUS_BIT(status, pos, value) ((status & ~(1ULL << pos)) | (unsigned long long) value << pos)
76# define SET_STATUS_ITEM1(status, value) ((status & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFF00) | (unsigned long long) value)
77# define SET_STATUS_ITEM2(status, value) ((status & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFF00FF) | (unsigned long long) value << 8)
78# define SET_STATUS_ITEM3(status, value) ((status & 0xFFFFFFFFFF00FFFF) | (unsigned long long) value << 16)
79# define SET_STATUS_ITEM4(status, value) ((status & 0xFFFFFFFF00FFFFFF) | (unsigned long long) value << 24)
80# define SET_STATUS_ITEM5(status, value) ((status & 0xFFFFFF00FFFFFFFF) | (unsigned long long) value << 32)
81# define SET_STATUS_ITEM6(status, value) ((status & 0xFFFF00FFFFFFFFFF) | (unsigned long long) value << 40)
82# define SET_STATUS_ITEM7(status, value) ((status & 0xFF00FFFFFFFFFFFF) | (unsigned long long) value << 48)
83# define SET_STATUS_ITEM8(status, value) ((status & 0x00FFFFFFFFFFFFFF) | (unsigned long long) value << 56)
84
85// macros for parsing values from status variable (more info at documentation of getRadarSystemState()):
86# define GET_STATUS_BIT(status, pos) ((bool) (status & (1ULL << pos)))
87# define GET_STATUS_ITEM1(status) ((uint8_t) (status & 0x00000000000000FF))
88# define GET_STATUS_ITEM2(status) ((uint8_t) ((status & 0x000000000000FF00) >> 8))
89# define GET_STATUS_ITEM3(status) ((uint8_t) ((status & 0x0000000000FF0000) >> 16))
90# define GET_STATUS_ITEM4(status) ((uint8_t) ((status & 0x00000000FF000000) >> 24))
91# define GET_STATUS_ITEM5(status) ((uint8_t) ((status & 0x000000FF00000000) >> 32))
92# define GET_STATUS_ITEM6(status) ((uint8_t) ((status & 0x0000FF0000000000) >> 40))
93# define GET_STATUS_ITEM7(status) ((uint8_t) ((status & 0x00FF000000000000) >> 48))
94# define GET_STATUS_ITEM8(status) ((uint8_t) ((status & 0xFF00000000000000) >> 56))
